brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir posted a video depicting Palestinians on conveyor belts moving toward detention camps, The Guardian reported. The imagery shows the Palestinians as objects passing along an industrial production line, a comparison that drew sharp condemnation for its dehumanizing portrayal.

Ben-Gvir, leader of the far-right Jewish Power party, has wielded significant influence over Israeli security policy since entering government. The post exemplifies rhetoric that critics say strips Palestinians of humanity in public discourse. Rights advocates have flagged such language as emblematic of the hardline approach that has defined the current Israeli administration's stance toward Palestinians in occupied territories.

title: Ben-Gvir posts video of Palestinians on conveyor belts to detention camps
